actions.name: place
actions.description: Place the selected stone at the cursor cell (read the pointer position in the same frame).

actions.name: cancel
actions.description: Deselect / close the radial menu; with nothing to cancel the game opens the pause menu.

actions.name: next_face
actions.description: Snap the camera to the next face of the slab.

actions.name: prev_face
actions.description: Snap the camera to the previous face of the slab.

actions.name: build_menu
actions.description: Open the radial build menu at the cursor.

actions.name: orbit
actions.description: Orbit the camera this frame, in drag pixels: +x = drag right, +y = drag down.

actions.name: zoom
actions.description: Zoom this frame, in wheel notches: + = closer.

actions.name: cursor_move
actions.description: Move the gamepad cursor this frame, in screen pixels (+y down); the game snaps it to placement cells. Mouse and touch place the cursor directly via the pointer.
